text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Five minutes have passed since our
designated departure time,
and yet
Yukino Bijin and Gold City are nowhere to
be seen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We don't necessarily have to go together.
We're all going to the same
place, right?
So what's the big deal?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, we don't have to go together, but since we're a team, I think we should!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The bus ride to the training camp is pretty
long, right? So I prepared
lots of stuff for
us to talk about! ♪ I can't wait to chat with
you all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your thoughtfulness, Curren
Chan. I, too, believe that in
order to make
this festival a success, we will need to work
as a team.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, we still have some time. Let's
wait five more minutes and
then—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: M-my apol'gies!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yukino and City, you made it! You
okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Wheeze... G-guys, I'm so sorry! I ended up spend'n too much time pack'n my stuff...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, it's my fault! Yukino's only late
because I overslept and she came
all the
way to the Ritto dorms to pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! I was already runn'n late by
the time I came t'pick you
up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but seriously, you were actually
getting ready. I just totally
screwed up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that's enough of fighting for the
blame!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We've got a bus to catch! We were just
saying we've got plenty of
time, so no hard
feelings. 'Kay?♪

text_block_list.name: City and Yukino
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Pretty sure this trip is gonna be
what you would call "an uphill
battle."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, do you think so? Well then, let's be
on our way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We're heeeeere! Wow, it's so traditional
and Japanese-feeling! How
exciting! ♪
Oh, Brian? Can I get a snap of you in front
of the inn?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You know... You haven't stopped
blathering since we got on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yeah, I'm just so excited! ♪ But that
makes me easy to get
along with, right?
I'm just like your bestie Maya!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're infuriatingly mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you must be the group from Tracen
Academy! I bet you're tired
from the long
journey. Please come in! Welcome to our
inn!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'm Symboli Rudolf, the one you
spoke to on the phone the
other day.
Thank you for your cooperation with this
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine! My grandchild is
an Umamusume too, and we
look forward
to the Fleetfoot Festival every year. Please
let me know
if I can help you with
anything!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We appreciate it. Now then, let us head to
our rooms and unpack our
things. When
that's finished, we'll have a briefing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone is ready. Then let's
begin.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The aim of this training camp is to improve
our skills in preparation
for the Fleetfoot
Festival. I want each of us to fully
comprehend the
roles and responsibilities
we were dealt, so allow me to explain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Firstly, Narita Brian. You will be
performing in the archery show with
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a ritual of unparalleled valor. With a
purified bow and arrow in
hand, the archer
must leap over rocks and cliffs on the
sacred
mountain as they shoot at a number
of targets that represent
misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or so it was. In modern times, the ritual
has been simplified, and now
there is only
one target set up in front of the sacred
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, archery practice will be
essential. I believe you have
some
experience with it, correct?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I had to go to lessons with my big sis.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Perhaps because it is tradition,
archery is a popular skill to learn
among
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have received instruction in the
past, but we will work together
to further
improve our skills at this camp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They've set up a temporary training
ground for us nearby. Our
equipment has
also arrived. Shall we begin practice this
afternoon,
Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm tired of having the Empress
yelling in one ear and my sister
blathering
on in the other. I get it—this is serious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you want me to do, I'll do it. But
I won't practice for a
moment longer than I
have to. I'm leaving as soon as I've got the
feel
for it back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's not a problem. Let's move
on to the ceremonial dance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Me, Yukino, and City are gonna
devote a dance to the
Three Goddesses,
right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We'll thank them for everything and ask
them to keep watching over
us... with our
super cute dance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Cute?! I-I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Yukino. So the lessons will be
in the local community hall,
and our
teacher is being sent from the URA, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The teacher is a member of the URA
who is well-versed in the
ceremonial
dance. They should be arriving this
afternoon, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've danced for my concerts before, but
I've never done a ritual dance
like this...
I'm gonna make sure I get it super cute
and polished! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good... Then we're all finished here.
Meeting adjourned! I expect
each of you
to dedicate yourselves to your training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot. There's one more
important thing I want you to
keep in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As Umamusume, our physical condition is
of utmost importance.
Please take care not
to get too overzealous.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In other words, during your training, be sure to stay on track!
